# The test files that still run a git commit in a scratch repository without the shared
# identity (internal/testgit), one `<file> <sites> <why>` per line, counted. Such a test
# passes on a bench whose global git config has an identity and fails on a hosted runner
# with `Author identity unknown`. The class test (git_identity_class_test.go) fails on an
# unlisted file, on a count that rose and on a count or a row that fell and was not
# lowered: the list only shrinks (NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers it, and never raises it).
